notes.title: UPDATE: BUILD 39 BLACKJACK
notes.content:
[b]ZONE 4 Update[/b] – Soul Blackjack & Visual Improvements!

[u]A major new feature is here[/u]:
You can now play BLACKJACK using SOULS in ZONE 4! Just head to the new "Sexy Cat" bar building to try it out.
・Wager your souls
・Low or High-stakes gameplay
・Rules can be read in-game — quick and easy to learn!

If players enjoy this, more games could be added in future updates.
💬 Share your thoughts via Steam Reviews or the Discussion page!

🎨 Visual Update
The blood and water art has been simplified for a cleaner, sharper look.

Enjoy!

notes.title: UPDATE: BUILD 38.4 SPIN&WIN+
notes.content:
[u]New Update Summary[/u]:

・[b]New Roulette-Like Feature[/b]: Introducing Netherspin, a game where you can win prizes with every spin for just 50 Sin Coins. (at Mr.Pumpkin's)
・[b]New Starting Card[/b]: SLICE N DICE: Now available in exchange for one of the two CHAINSAW cards.
・[b]Lore Updates[/b]: Two new lore notes added, one regarding Sin Coins and another from James (Note: "Gamble Coins" have been renamed to "Sin Coins").
・[b]Icon Update[/b]: The grilled fish icon has been significantly altered to avoid resembling raw fish.
・[b]BBQ Quantity Display[/b]: The BBQ quantity is now shown before the image, instead of after.
・[b]Animation Enhancements[/b]: Various animation improvements, such as a more pronounced burp effect for SCREAMSODA.

・[b]Bug Fix[/b]: TRINGTRING now has a 100% hit rate as stated on the card (previously 95%).

Enjoy!
More updates coming soon.

notes.title: UPDATE: BUILD 38.3 SLOT MACHINE+
notes.content:
[u]New Update Summary[/u]:

・Added new Slot Machine Gambling System.
・Introducing Mr. Pumpkin as shopkeeper.
・Mr. Pumpkin appears in Zones 1, 3, and 6 (every 2nd map), selling two consistent items for now.
・Coins can now be found randomly inside some houses.

[u]How the Portable Slot Machine works[/u]:
- Select "portable slot machine" item from inventory
- Your current total coins are visible here
- Place a 10-coin bet per row and spin
- Matching symbols from the far left results in a win
- Winnings are calculated as 10× the chart number
- A detailed guide will be added in a future update

・Card "TRINKTRINK" base DMG increased from 7 to 9 for a stronger start
・Improved Sin Cards description text sorting for some cards

[b]Why is Mr.Pumpkin's shop important?[/b] It’s the first step toward buying and selling items, cards, and raw materials. A more advanced purchase menu is also in development.

More updates coming soon! :)

notes.title: UPDATE: BUILD 38.1
notes.content:
[b]Update Summary:[/b]

・[b]New Starting Card:[/b] BLOODBOAT now available! Set sail for battle with a powerful new beginning
・[b]New Lore Pages[/b] have been written. Soon you'll be able to find them scattered throughout the Netherworld and gain bonus EXP!
・[b]Level-Up Stat Adjustment:[/b] HP gain per level has been reduced from 10 to 5, and MP from 50 to 10. Balance your build strategically using the new Skilltree! More unlockable skills coming
・[b]Balance Update:[/b] The "GEORGE" card now dodges 50% damage (previously 80%), for better late-game fairness
・[b]Bug Fix:[/b] Resolved an error when exiting the skilltree while another menu was open
・[b]Battle Background Music[/b] added to intensify the Zone 2 "boss" fight!

More updates coming!

notes.title: UPDATE: BUILD 38 [Skilltree]
notes.content:
[u]New Features in This Update[/u]:

・[b]Basic SKILLTREE![/b]
Players naturally gain HP and MP with each level-up. In addition to this, you can now allocate skill points to enhance your stats. This update also introduces a new on-screen button for easy access. Please note that some battles have been rebalanced to account for these changes.

Future updates will include additional stats, cards, items, and more!

[u]Gameplay Balancing Changes Due to Skill Tree Stats[/u]:
・[b]Mine Gold HP Cost:[/b] Adjusted from -5 HP to -10 HP (with a small chance to receive more than 1 gold)
・[b]Enemy FLAYER [Level 6]:[/b] One of its attacks has been increased by 30%
・[b]Enemy SHALOM [Level 4]:[/b] The Life Drain and HP Recovery abilities have been enhanced

See you in the next update!

notes.title: Mini Update
notes.content:
・New Battle Music added.
・Card: Poison card "Vommy" from 5% to 3% damage.
・Card: Poison card "Positive" from 8% to 5% damage.
・Only different poison cards can stack damage each turn.
・Portable BBQ item has "nevermind" option to close quantity window.

I plan to add more content and zones, and the poison cards were a bit overpowered, as they could easily wipe out bosses and high HP enemies later on.

Thank you!
